svg.title: ExPO: self-explanation policy optimization
svg.desc: On a hard problem all of the model's own samples are wrong, so GRPO gets no signal; an expert chain of thought is correct but has almost zero probability under the policy. ExPO conditions on the ground-truth answer to produce a self-explanation that is likely under the policy and makes the correct answer likely; training on it shifts the policy toward correct reasoning.

g.text: Hard problem: every sampled answer is wrong
Expert CoT: correct, but far off-policy
ExPO: let the model explain the known answer
Train on it → policy moves to correct reasoning
c̃ used as a positive sample
correct samples appear → RL takes off
